name: Mark types on, cuts to black
looks: A small hand-drawn squiggle mark settles above a short closing line that types on with a blinking cursor, the line ending mid-word in a cursive script as it hard-cuts to black.
build: script-accent-underline's typing mechanic without the underline, holding on the mark; the hard cut to black lands exactly on the beat, leaving the line unfinished to pull the viewer into the next card or the CTA that follows.
sound: A soft typewriter clack per character cutting to silence on the hard cut.
prompt: Close on a small hand-drawn mark above a warm closing line typing on with a blinking cursor, and hard-cut to black mid-word so the line feels like it continues just past the frame, pulling the viewer toward the next beat.
